items.title: TCS Q2 review: Analysts flag weak margins amid steady growth; stock up 4%
items.description: TCS reported a net profit of ₹13,884 crore for Q2FY27, up 14.9 per cent year-on-year from ₹12,075 crore in Q2FY26. Revenue for the company grew 11.2 per cent in reported terms at ₹73,188 crore

items.title: Will Nifty register its 9th straight weekly loss? Here's what analysts say
